frequency_question: How often does a central bank successfully execute the administrative and technical steps required to deploy a temporary reserve ratio adjustment within a sub-four-month window?
membership_rule: Includes any primary central bank announcement and implementation of targeted incremental reserve ratios or special liquidity absorption windows with less than 120 days total notice. Excludes standard annual policy rate adjustments.
